part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `Replacer.replace` (replacer.go:136): when the input contained no opening brace `{`, it returned the string immediately without processing escape sequences — so `\}` kept its backslash while `\{` (which contains `{`) went through the escape-handling scanner. This is why `uri replace "\}" %7D` failed while `"\{"` worked.

The fix adds a check for the closing brace so inputs containing `\}` also enter the escape-processing path:
- `"\}"` → `}`, `"\\}"` → `\}` (literal backslash preserved), and plain `}` unchanged.

Verified: all replacer tests (including the `TestReplacer` case expecting `\}` → `}`), the `caddytest` adapt test `uri_replace_brace_escape.txt` covering the exact issue config, and the `caddyconfig`/`caddyhttp`/`rewrite` test suites all pass. The two TLS-related integration test failures (`TestACMEServerDirectory`, `TestHTTPRedirectWrapperWithLargeUpload`) fail identically on the clean tree, so they're pre-existing container-environment issues.
